name: Nihongo Master v1.3.1 - HUD Box Boundary Fix & Turbo Heat Balancing
changelog: v1.3.1: Fixed HUD pill box bounds in Hiragana Fighter. Unified pill dimensions (270x36) and centered layout so that COMBO, TURBO HEAT, and OVERHEAT! text and gauge bars never exceed box borders. Rebalanced turbo heat rate with 50% less heat accumulation (~9.1s of sustained turbo before overheat) and faster cooldown. Enhanced left stage telemetry and goal badge margins.
